brief.title: Moss & Mortar
brief.artStyle: soft painterly storybook illustration, gouache and watercolor textures, rounded friendly shapes, gentle hand-inked outlines in warm brown, diffused golden-hour lighting, mossy greens, cream and pond-teal palette with peachy highlights
brief.fontVibe: chunky hand-lettered storybook serif with wobbly rounded edges, letters look like stacked mossy stones with tiny leaf sprouts, ampersand shaped like a curled vine, cream fill with deep green outline
brief.logoPrompt: Hand-lettered game title logo reading "Moss & Mortar" in quotes exactly, centered, chunky rounded storybook lettering shaped like mossy stacked stones with cream fill, deep pond-green outline, small leaf sprouts and a curling vine ampersand, soft painterly texture, isolated on a flat solid plain white background, no scene, no other text
brief.emblemPrompt: Simple bold flat vector emblem of a cute round frog head wearing a tiny stone castle tower as a crown, moss-green and cream with deep pond-green outline and a peach accent, rounded shapes, centered, iconic, no text or letters
brief.keyArtPrompt: Cinematic wide key art, soft painterly storybook illustration, gouache and watercolor textures, rounded friendly shapes, warm golden-hour light: a team of cheerful frogs in tiny aprons and helmets stacking mossy stone walls on a lily-pad castle at the edge of a glowing pond, while a swirling autumn storm of rain and leaves gathers on the horizon, fireflies and warm lantern glow, mossy greens, cream and teal palette with peach highlights, calm misty empty sky in the center-upper area for a logo, no text, no letters, no logos
brief.stingPrompt: 5 seconds: slow cinematic push-in on the key art as drifting leaves and glowing fireflies float across the frame, gentle rain ripples spread on the pond, a soft warm light sweep passes over the logo making it glint once, the storm clouds in the distance gently churn. Sound design: soft pond ambience with a few frog ribbits, a warm plucky ukulele and music-box melody, a satisfying stone-clack as the logo settles, ending on a gentle chime.

brief.storeBlurb: Rally your froggy friends and raise a castle from moss, mud and mortar! Work together to stack walls, set cozy defenses and shelter your pond kingdom from every storm the seasons throw at it.
features: Build and rebuild your pond castle together in co-op
Defend against spring showers, summer squalls and winter freezes
Decorate with mossy, mushroomy, lantern-lit charm
Play with friends in relaxed, welcoming sessions
